note: Larkspur’s three teams and what each needs, hand-set for the workbench. A team’s quality is the share of its own questions a machine gets right (support’s is the 20 questions); price and wait come from its typical request. A team’s machine is the one that meets every need.

teams.name: Support
teams.job: Drafts replies while a customer waits on chat.

teams.name: Warehouse
teams.job: Answers stock questions over long inventory tables.

teams.name: Catalogue
teams.job: Writes product pages overnight; nobody waits.
